codex_consult.feedback_summary: Choose Path A but not as a literal 'if ssn resolves' patch. Five refinements: (1) ssn does not resolve on real spawn-end unless end-side adds receiverThreadIds[0]-based resolution and binds both callSubagentKey(call) and receiverThreadId to the new ssn. (2) Beware start/end call-id mismatch — refine to 'allocate provisional sessionSubagent on spawn-begin keyed by call even when receiverThreadIds is empty, emit spawn start + lifecycle start immediately with that id, bind real receiver thread id on spawn-end' (Path A+ hybrid). Keep retro-create-on-end as fallback for completed-only/reordered/new variants. (3) Double-fire is manageable via existing emitLifecycleStart idempotency on sessionSubagent. (4) agentNickname cannot be recovered from current app-server ThreadItem; upstream CollabAgentSpawnEndEvent.new_agent_nickname is dropped by event_mapping.rs — null is acceptable. (5) Path C is not better — couples Happy to Codex internals and does not solve call-id pairing without app-server surface changes. Path B works but unnecessarily delays UI.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: All five refinements incorporated. Refinement #1+#2 (the Path A+ hybrid) is now the primary strategy in development_approach, requirements M2+M5, and AC1+AC2. Refinement #3 (idempotency reliance) is M4 + AC2 + pre_existing_guards entry for line 59. Refinement #4 (null agentNickname) is W3 in the spec. Refinement #5 (Path C/B rejection) is W1 + W2 in the spec. Pure 'Path A retro-create on end' is explicitly rejected — replaced with Path A+.
